name: dormer
description: Dormer (老虎窗) generator: a small roofed window box protruding from a main roof slope. Variants: gabled (狗屋式双坡), shed (单坡), hipped (四坡). Emits the dormer body (window wall + sill + mini roof + cheeks) plus explicit minecraft:air cells that carve the window tunnel INTO the main slope — the opening cuts into the slope, it is not pasted onto it. All stair/slab states derived from origin+params.
when_to_use: Main roof is already built and needs attic light, headroom, or a break in a long monotonous slope. origin = the bottom-LEFT cell of the window wall AS SEEN FROM OUTSIDE, y = the slope-surface layer the dormer wall rises from (the wall base replaces/sits on that slope row). facing = downhill direction of the host slope (the way the window looks out). DIRECTION STATES ARE DERIVED BY THE SCRIPT — never hand-edit facing/half/shape in the output JSON; change params and re-run (禁止手改方向状态).
use_for: 大屋顶/阁楼采光、长坡面打破单调、农舍/乡村/法式屋顶构件;mansard 几乎必配;thatched/cottage 风用 gabled,现代/棚屋用 shed,庄重体量用 hipped

origin.notes: 窗墙下沿左角(从外面看的左侧);y = 窗墙所在的坡面层

facing.notes: 窗朝向 = 主坡的下坡方向

width.notes: 窗墙宽;2=两格窗,3=中单窗,4=双窗

variant.notes: gabled=狗屋双坡(最经典);shed=单坡(带前墙过梁);hipped=四坡(缓金字塔帽)

depth.notes: 迷你屋顶伸进坡面的进深;必须小于主坡剩余进深

roof_material.notes: 迷你屋顶;一般与主屋顶同款

window_material.notes: 窗洞填充;要真通风可换 minecraft:air

cheeks.notes: 两侧腮墙填到窗墙底层,把窗体嵌进坡面

pitfalls: 窗洞必须切进坡面而不是贴在坡上 —— 输出里的 minecraft:air 单元就是干这个的(打通窗洞到阁楼),禁止删掉;没有 place_air 能力时先手工挖掉对应坡面块再放置
origin 的 y 必须取窗墙下沿所在的坡面层:太高窗墙悬空,太低窗墙被坡面埋半截;沿坡每上坡 1 格 y 抬 1
老虎窗只开一个坡面,别跨屋脊放;两个坡面都要就分两次生成(facing 相反)
depth 超过主坡剩余进深会从屋脊穿出去 —— 先量坡面进深再定 depth
shed 变体前墙顶部有一排过梁墙(y=2),删了窗顶就漏;gabled 奇数宽屋脊半砖下有填充支撑,别挖
width=2 时窗洞会打穿两侧腮墙(y=1 各留一道槽),这是 2 格宽老虎窗的正常窗侧壁,不是 bug
迷你屋顶楼梯 facing 一律指向坡内/屋脊(高侧),脚本已推导;手改朝向=坡面漏水
example: python patterns/dormer.py --params '{"origin":[100,80,100],"facing":"south","width":3,"variant":"gabled"}' --out dormer1.json && python patterns/dormer.py --params '{"origin":[100,80,110],"facing":"east","width":2,"variant":"shed"}' --out dormer2.json
